cong_thuc.cu_phap: Right-click Ribbon > Customize the Ribbon > tick Developer
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Hien the Developer moi thay Record Macro, Button, Visual Basic.

cong_thuc.cu_phap: Developer > Record Macro: ten viet lien khong dau; Shortcut key bo trong; Store in: This Workbook
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Bat dau ghi: moi click/go duoc dich sang VBA. Dat ten viet lien (Thang1), tranh trung Ctrl+C.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Record ten Thang1 > click sang sheet Du lieu 1 > Stop

cong_thuc.cu_phap: Stop Recording (nut vuong Developer / thanh trang thai)
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Dung ghi sau khi xong thao tac. Quen Stop se ghi thua.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Bam nut vuong Stop sau khi chuyen sheet

cong_thuc.cu_phap: Sub TenMacro() ... End Sub (trong Module, xem bang Alt+F11)
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Moi macro la 1 Sub. F5 hoac nut tam giac de chay trong VBE.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Alt+F11 > Module1 > Sub GhiMacro() ... End Sub > F5

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Bien dong thanh chu thich (mau xanh); dung vo hieu dong thua nhu Range("D9").Select.
Selection = vung dang chon (tong quat); Range co dinh chi chay dung o cu. Muon ap moi o phai xoa dong co dinh.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Xoa Range("D9").Select, giu Selection.Font.Bold=True > chay o bat ky

cong_thuc.cu_phap: Developer > Insert > Button > ve nut > Assign Macro
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Tao nut bam chay macro. Ve xong chon macro trong Assign Macro.

cong_thuc.cu_phap: Insert > Shapes > ve hinh > Right-click > Assign Macro
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Dung Shape dep hon nut mac dinh, cung gan macro de bam chay.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Ve Shape 'Du lieu thang 1' > Assign Macro Thang1

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Lenh record duoc khi click qua sheet; dung lam muc luc nhay sheet.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Record click sang Du lieu 1 (sinh Sheets("Du lieu 1").Select)

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Nhan nhanh nut sang sheet khac; nut copy giu nguyen macro da gan.

cong_thuc.ten: Tim dong trong — Ctrl+Mui ten xuong
cong_thuc.cu_phap: Ctrl + Mui ten xuong (trong sheet Data)
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Nhay toi dong cuoi co du lieu de them dong tiep (macro nhap lieu).
cong_thuc.vi_du: O B3 > Ctrl+Mui ten xuong (toi day) + BAT Relative + xuong 1 o

cong_thuc.cu_phap: Developer > Use Relative References: BAT truoc doan dich tuong doi, TAT sau paste
cong_thuc.giai_thich: BAT thi buoc mui ten ghi tuong doi (dich theo vi tri); tat cho buoc tuyet doi. Dau hieu BAT: nut chim/mo.
cong_thuc.vi_du: BAT Relative > mui ten xuong 1 o > Paste > TAT Relative

cong_thuc.cu_phap: Paste Special > Transpose (xoay cot thanh hang)
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Input nhap doc, Data luu ngang nen record thao tac xoay khi paste.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Copy vung doc Input > Paste Special > Transpose sang Data

cong_thuc.cu_phap: Ctrl+T (Format as Table) truoc khi record loc
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Bien vung thanh Table on dinh, Advanced Filter record on dinh khi them dong.
Giu lai macro/Button. Luu .xlsx se MAT macro khi mo lai.

cong_thuc.ten: Hoc lenh qua VBE — Alt+F11 + Ctrl+G
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Mo song song de hoc lenh: record VLOOKUP/Filter/Format roi doc code sinh ra.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Record go VLOOKUP > Alt+F11 xem code

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Xoa dinh dang vung test truoc khi bam nut de thay ro ket qua macro.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Boi den vung test > Clear Formats > bam nut

steps.thao_tac: Buoc 1 (Bat Developer + chuan bi sheet): Right-click Ribbon > Customize > tick Developer > Chuan bi Main (muc luc), Du lieu 1/2/3, Input, Data, Tim kiem
Buoc 2 (Muc luc nhay sheet): Ve Shape 'Du lieu thang 1' > Record Thang1 (This Workbook) > click Du lieu 1 > Stop > Assign macro vao shape > Lap Thang2/Thang3 tuong tu
Buoc 3 (Nut quay lai + copy nut): Record QuayLaiMain (click ve Main) > tao nut tren moi sheet du lieu > gan macro > Copy/Paste hoac Ctrl+keo nut (giu macro)
steps.luu_y: Kiem tra vung sau paste/fill; Ctrl+Z ngay neu sai

steps.thao_tac: Buoc 4 (Nhap lieu tu dong (Relative+Transpose)): Tao nut 'Cap nhat' > Record: copy Input > sang Data > B3 > Ctrl+Mui ten xuong > BAT Relative > xuong 1 o > Paste Special Transpose > TAT Relative > ve Input xoa trang > Stop > gan nut > Test NV moi (vd so 4) sang Data kiem tra
steps.luu_y: Kiem tra vung sau paste/fill; Ctrl+Z ngay neu sai

steps.thao_tac: Buoc 5 (Tim kiem Advanced Filter + .xlsm): Ctrl+T chuan hoa vung > record Advanced Filter (Ho Nguyen, Nu...) > gan nut Tim kiem/Tim moi > Alt+F11 xoa dong Range thua, them ' ghi chu; test 2-3 lan; luu .xlsm

Thực hiện bước: Buoc 2 (Muc luc nhay sheet): Ve Shape 'Du lieu thang 1' > Record Thang1 (This Workbook) > click Du lieu 1 > Stop > Assign macro vao shape > Lap Thang2/Thang3 tu
Thực hiện bước: Buoc 3 (Nut quay lai + copy nut): Record QuayLaiMain (click ve Main) > tao nut tren moi sheet du lieu > gan macro > Copy/Paste hoac Ctrl+keo nut (giu macro)
Thực hiện bước: Buoc 4 (Nhap lieu tu dong (Relative+Transpose)): Tao nut 'Cap nhat' > Record: copy Input > sang Data > B3 > Ctrl+Mui ten xuong > BAT Relative > xuong 1 o > Past
Thực hiện bước: Buoc 5 (Tim kiem Advanced Filter + .xlsm): Ctrl+T chuan hoa vung > record Advanced Filter (Ho Nguyen, Nu...) > gan nut Tim kiem/Tim moi > Alt+F11 xoa dong Range
